scope: All 98 deduplicated eligible external URLs extracted from the current 23 target files: README, SOURCES, eleven chapters and ten reading cards, including spatial-tokens-and-position. HEAD only; all final status 200, so no GET fallback or missing-link retry was needed. TLS and inherited proxy retained. Normal redirects are recorded with original source URLs preserved. This checks HTTP reachability, not page content, fragment targets, source claims or scientific accuracy. PDF/model/binary assets and own-repository links excluded.
